title: HELIX Terminology: Experiential Learning Type
description: Types of experiential learning and High-Impact Practices (HIPs). Used by ExperientialLearning. Aligned with NSSE High-Impact Practices.

codes.definition: Supervised professional work experience, often for academic credit
Structured alternation of academic study and full-time paid employment
Supervised practical application of coursework in a professional setting
Supervised clinical experience in health-professions programs
Supervised classroom teaching experience for education majors
Community service integrated with academic instruction and reflection
Learning in a real-world field setting
Short-term job shadowing or observational experience
Structured earn-and-learn program combining work and instruction

notes: Internships, undergraduate research, service learning, study abroad, and capstones are recognized NSSE High-Impact Practices (HIPs).
